description: Find verbatim passages where people at organizations described how they use AI, ranked by relevance with checked passages and the clearest statements first. Each result has speaker, role, organization, date, source, evidence grade, verification status and its own link. Returns nothing when the archive holds nothing on point.

grade.description: Only these grades, comma separated, e.g. "A,B".

limit.description: How many passages to return (1 to 25).

organization.description: Only passages about this organization (id or name), e.g. "Stripe".

person.description: Only passages from this speaker (id or name).

query.description: The question or subject in plain words, e.g. "agents doing code review".

topic.description: Only passages on this topic id (see list_topics).

verified_only.description: Only passages checked against the source.

name: search_passages
title: Search passages
